name: kernel
description: KERNEL classifies each task by domain, work shape, and safety level, then loads only the guidance that classification requires. Ordinary work runs with no ceremony; protected work gets externally enforced safety checks; genuinely iterative work gets a feedback loop. Durable memory, bounded resume manifests, and destructive-operation guards are included and work without any external directory tree.
